The document states the RGPH 2024 was carried out, the previous census having been in 2014, and uses its results (66.3% effective social coverage of the employed aged 18+). Document gives no enumeration date; year 2024 used.
The document reports INS Flash TIC indicators drawn from the 2024 census, with internet use asked for the three months preceding the census. Document gives no enumeration date; year 2024 used.

facts.fact: The World Bank's WDI lists 2014 as Tunisia's latest population census.
The World Bank's WDI lists an integrated household survey (IHS) of 2015 as the source of Tunisia's most recent income and expenditure data.
